title: Git & Collaboration
motto: Version control is not optional. Every experiment, every model, every lesson you build here gets tracked.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Version control is not optional. Every experiment, every model, every lesson you build here gets tracked.

steps.title: Why git first
cards: You'll write hundreds of files across 20 phases. Without version control you lose work, can't undo mistakes, and can't collaborate.
Git is the tool. GitHub is where code lives. Save often, push to remote, branch for experiments.

steps.title: The daily workflow
steps.body: Working directory → git add (staging) → git commit (local snapshot) → git push (remote backup). Branch with git checkout -b for experiments without breaking main.

steps.title: Implement should_gitignore
steps.body: AI repos accumulate huge binaries. Write should_gitignore(path, patterns) — return True if path ends with any pattern suffix (e.g. .pt, .pth).
